subject: Re: Developer quickstart — technical demo request and scheduling
messages:
From: Kai Morgan <kai@applify.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Developer quickstart - technical demo request

Hi Olga,

We just finished the developer quickstart on Redwood (nice docs — thanks!). I went through the embeddings + streaming examples and we started prototyping a low-latency reranking flow. We're seeing good results in the sandbox but have a few production questions around KV cache sizing, batching tradeoffs, and model fallback behavior.

Would love to get a short technical demo / onboarding — ideally with an engineer on your side who can walk our lead infra engineer through the runtime behaviors and what to expect when we move to dedicated capacity.

A couple of quick details:
- Company: Applify AI (seed-stage, prototype in GCP us-west1)
- Use case: real-time inference + reranking for search
- Preferred time: this week in the afternoon PST

I've attached a quickstart log and the small trace we captured during the run.

Thanks,
Kai Morgan
APplify AI — Head of Engineering
kai@applify.ai
Attachment: quickstart-logs.txt (text)

Hi Kai — thanks for reaching out and for trying the quickstart. Happy to set this up. Olga is our solutions engineer and will run the demo; I'll coordinate calendar details.

Do any of these windows work for you (all PST):
- Wed 6/20, 2:00–2:30pm
- Thu 6/21, 4:00–4:30pm
- Fri 6/22, 10:30–11:00am

We'll plan for a 30-minute technical onboarding: agenda will be — 10m intros + goals, 15m runtime deep-dive (KV cache, batching, model variants), 5m next steps. If you want more hands-on debugging please note your priority items and we can extend.

Also, could you confirm who will attend from your side and whether you prefer a recorded session? For prep, here's an agenda stub and a short pre-demo checklist.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Growth SDR | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com

Hi Kai / Samantha — thanks for confirming. I've scheduled Wed, Jun 20 at 2:00–2:30pm PST and sent the calendar invite (attached .ics). Dev Patel, our runtime lead, will join to cover KV cache sizing and quantization guidance.

Short agenda (we'll stick to 30m):
- 5m intros + goals (Kai + Samantha)
- 15m runtime behavior: batching, KV cache patterns, model fallback, quantization recommendations (Dev)
- 5m sample troubleshooting + next steps (Olga)
- 5m action items & follow-ups (all)

Pre-demo ask: please confirm below by EOD Tue if you can share a sanitized sequence-length histogram from your quickstart run or confirm the typical request sizes (tokens in / tokens out). That will help us focus the recommendations.

Recording: yes, we'll record and share the recording.

Meeting invite: redwood-technical-invite.ics (attached)
Prep doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cDemoPrep

Looking forward — see you Wed.
